issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the appellants had an internal flight alternative in Mendoza
issues.applicant_position: The RPD erred in assessing corroborating evidence and in concluding a viable IFA exists in Mendoza.
issues.result_text: Fatal error in the second prong of the IFA analysis; the claims must be re-determined by the RPD.

issues.issue: Whether the female appellant's claim succeeds under section 96 given her free services to Gypsies
issues.respondent_position: Claims must be examined under section 97; section 96 needs a Convention ground, which the free services lack.
issues.result_text: The appellant's free services to Gypsies do not align with the purpose of refugee protection.

issues.issue: Whether state protection is available to the appellants in Argentina
issues.result_text: Court cannot resolve state protection without questioning the appellants, so it refers the matter back to the RPD.
